args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Add a .catch() handler to reset busy state (setBusy(false)) and show an error toast when exportReport fails, ensuring the export button is re-enabled.
args.title: Re-enable export button on export failure in ExportButton.tsx

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

ExportButton.tsx calls exportReport(reportId, format).then(...) but does not handle rejection, leaving busy set to true and the button disabled. Adding a catch handler will reset the busy state and show an error toast when export fails.
